purpose: Teach: カバー/臭い/クマ/思いっきり/水分/どっか/品物/大根

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のテーブル、本気で、絶対、カバー、絶対、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the way you've styled the table covers is genuinely beautiful.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone. Soft emphasis on the word 'genuinely' — not performative, real appreciation. Gentle pace, leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ゴミ箱、絶対、臭い、絶対、対策、絶対、しないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, we really do need to tackle the trash bin situation — it's starting to get to me.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not unkind. Light, practical energy. Acknowledging the problem without dramatics. A small laugh beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、クマ、絶対、目の下、絶対、葵、絶対、お疲れね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've got dark circles, Aoi. You look exhausted.
lines.style: Soft concern. No hedging — direct observation, but said with care. Quiet, steady tone. Eyes meeting hers.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、思いっきり、絶対、楽しんでほしいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really want you to actually enjoy yourself, you know?
lines.style: Sincere, a little urgent. The words come from underneath — not a suggestion but a small plea. Warm, no distance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、水分、絶対、補給、絶対、大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It matters that customers stay hydrated. You know that.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing. Not lecturing — she understands Aoi gets it. Slow, thoughtful. A reminder wrapped in care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、どっか、絶対、新店舗、絶対、開けたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd love to open a new place somewhere. Something bigger.
lines.style: Hopeful, quieter than expected. A small dream surfacing. Pace softens on the second thought — she's letting herself say it out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、品物、絶対、お客様、絶対、喜ぶわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customers are going to love those elegant pieces you pick.
lines.style: Affirming, steady. Belief in her eye for detail. Warm but grounded — not flattery, certainty. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、大根、絶対、サラダ、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、お試しよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The daikon salad is our new special — you should try it when you get a moment.
lines.style: Animated, inviting. Light energy — excited about the menu addition. Ends on a small smile, generous invite. Brighter closing.
